name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Success Manager
summary: Customer onboarding and success professional with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, owning the first 30–60 days of the post-sale journey and turning complex products into fast, measurable value for non-technical users. I build onboarding plans, act as the customer's trusted point of contact after signup, and drive the adoption and retention that keep customers for the long haul — comfortable wearing many hats on a lean, fully remote team.
